info.title: v2.media.init_video_upload
info.description: Use this API to initialize a new video upload task and obtain a unique upload session ID.

post.description: Use this API to initialize a new video upload task and obtain a unique upload session ID.

parameters.name: business
parameters.description: Defines the business type of the uploaded image. Supported values: 3 = Video

parameters.name: duration
parameters.description: Video duration in seconds. Rules and restrictions by business and scene: - If business = 3 (Video) and scene = 1 (Shopee Video): 1s~180s.

parameters.name: file_size
parameters.description: Total video file size in bytes. Rules and restrictions by business and scene: - If business = 3 (Video) and scene = 1 (Shopee Video): Maximum 1GB.

parameters.name: partner_id
parameters.description: Partner ID is assigned upon registration is successful. Required for all requests.

parameters.name: scene
parameters.description: Defines the purpose of the uploaded image under the specified business type. Supported values: - If business = 3 (Video): 1 = Shopee Video

parameters.name: sign
parameters.description: Signature generated by partner_id, api path, timestamp and partner_key via HMAC-SHA256 hashing algorithm. More details: https://open.shopee.com/documents?module=87&type=2&id=58&version=2

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: This is to indicate the timestamp of the request. Required for all requests. Expires in 5 minutes.

200.description: Response documented by Shopee Open Platform.

<?php

$curl = curl_init();

curl_setopt_array($curl, array(
  CURLOPT_URL => 'https://partner.shopeemobile.com/api/v2/media/init_video_upload?partner_id=partner_id&sign=sign&timestamp=timestamp',
  CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER => true,
  CURLOPT_ENCODING => '',
  CURLOPT_MAXREDIRS => 10,
  CURLOPT_TIMEOUT => 0,
  CURLOPT_FOLLOWLOCATION => true,
  CURLOPT_HTTP_VERSION => CURL_HTTP_VERSION_1_1,
  CURLOPT_CUSTOMREQUEST => 'POST',
  CURLOPT_POSTFIELDS => '{
    "business": 3,
    "duration": 105,
    "file_name": "test_video_name.mp4",
    "file_size": 26214400,
    "scene": 1
}',
  CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER => array(
    'Content-Type: application/json'
  ),
));

$response = curl_exec($curl);

curl_close($curl);
echo $response;

import requests
import json

url = "https://partner.shopeemobile.com/api/v2/media/init_video_upload?partner_id=partner_id&sign=sign&timestamp=timestamp"

payload=json.dumps({
  "business": 3,
  "duration": 105,
  "file_name": "test_video_name.mp4",
  "file_size": 26214400,
  "scene": 1
})
headers = {
  'Content-Type': 'application/json'
}
response = requests.RPCRequest("POST",url,headers=headers, data=payload, allow_redirects=False)

print(response.text)
